title: One Wound Care Supply Program Enrollment per Wound Location
content:
# Programs per wound — Wound Care Supply Program

Intake rule on how many wound care programs a customer may hold.

## Rule

A customer may hold up to 4 Wound Care Supply Program programs at the same time, one for each wound, because dressings are ordered, evaluated and covered wound by wound. A new wound care program is opened only when the customer has no wound care program for the same wound location in referral received, pending authorization, active or on hold; a change of dressing for an existing wound is a program change, and a closed program does not count.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Customer's existing programs for the wound location of the referral | New program for that location |
|---|---|
| none | may be opened |
| one in referral received, pending authorization, active or on hold | not opened |
| only closed programs | may be opened — a closed program does not count |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A customer has an active program for a wound on the left heel and a new written order changes that wound's dressing from foam to alginate. This is a program change on the existing program, not a new program.
- A customer has an active program for a wound on the left heel and is referred for a second wound on the sacrum. The sacrum is a different wound location, so a new program may be opened, as long as the customer holds no more than 4 wound care programs at the same time.
- A customer's program for a wound on the right shin was closed, and the wound is referred again. The closed program does not count, so a new program may be opened for that location.
